# Contract: Background Runs and Progress

*Generated by spec-writer. Hand edits are overwritten on regeneration.*

## Prerequisites

These conditions describe the environment in which items in this
contract are exercised. Producing them is part of the feature's
deliverable, alongside the implementation itself — a contract whose
prerequisites are not yet satisfied is not failing, it is still being
built. Once the feature is delivered, any missing condition halts item
execution until it is restored.

**Runtime services:**
- Docker Engine with Compose v2 is installed and its daemon is running
- `uv` is on PATH and can provision Python 3.12; backend dependencies are installed with `uv sync` in `backend/`; the `bugflow` binary built by that install can be spawned as a child process
- a PostgreSQL 17 server with the `vector` extension available (the `db` service of `docker-compose.yml`) is running and healthy
- the database reached through the supplied database URL has its schema initialized (application tables present, `vector` extension installed) and holds no rows unless a Persistent state entry or an item says otherwise; items that need an uninitialized database state so in their `given`
- a stand-in for the OpenAI API is running on a loopback port it chooses and reports when it starts; it is delivered by an earlier feature (under `backend/tests/mocks/`) and is described under External dependencies
- for service and worker items, a background runner built in-process on the database engine and a client factory (see Configuration) is available, and is shut down after each item

**Persistent state:**
- bug `open-bug` is the only bug and has status `open`, title "Checkout button does nothing on Safari 17", description "Clicking Place order shows no response and no network call.", reproduction steps "Add an item, go to checkout in Safari 17, click the button.", system version "web 3.8.2", environment `production` and reporting team `support`; it has no embedding, no result row and no run. Used by `SVC-START-01`, `SVC-START-06`, `SVC-START-07`, `WRK-TRIAGE-01`, `WRK-TRIAGE-02`, `WRK-TRIAGE-03`, `E2E-CLI-RUN-01`, `E2E-CLI-RUN-02`, `E2E-CRASH-01`.
- bug `failed-bug` is the only bug, has status `failed` and valid values for every other column; no run exists. Used by `SVC-START-05`.
- bug `processing-bug` is the only bug, has status `processing` and valid values for every other column; no run exists. Used by `SVC-START-02`.
- bug `processed-bug` is the only bug, has status `processed` and valid values for every other column; no run exists. Used by `SVC-START-03`, `SVC-START-ALL-03`.
- exactly three bugs exist, titled "Bug one", "Bug two" and "Bug three", each with status `open` and valid values for every other column; no run exists; handle `three-open-bugs`. Used by `SVC-START-ALL-01`, `WRK-TRIAGE-04`, `WRK-TRIAGE-ALL-01`, `WRK-TRIAGE-ALL-02`, `WRK-TRIAGE-ALL-03`, `WRK-QUEUE-01`.
- exactly four bugs exist, titled "Mixed open" (status `open`), "Mixed processed" (status `processed`), "Mixed failed" (status `failed`) and "Mixed processing" (status `processing`), each with valid values for every other column; no run exists; handle `mixed-status-bugs`. Used by `SVC-START-ALL-02`.
- the 20 packaged seed bugs exist, all with status `open`, and no embedding exists; no run exists; handle `seeded-bugs`. Used by `SVC-START-09`, `WRK-OPERATIONS-02`, `WRK-OPERATIONS-03`, `WRK-OPERATIONS-04`.
- bug `streamed-bug` has status `processing` and valid values for every other column, and run `running-run` is the only run; handle `streaming-state`. `running-run` has type `triage`, bug `streamed-bug`, status `running`, progress 1 of 5 and no finish time. It has five steps: position 1 with key `component_classifier`, status `succeeded`, a stored input, a stored output and a duration of 1200 ms; position 2 with key `severity_classifier`, status `running` and a stored input; positions 3, 4 and 5 with keys `technical_analyst`, `resolution_manager` and `bug_documenter`, status `pending`. It has exactly three log lines, all at level INFO and written in this order: "AG1 Component Classifier started", "AG1 Component Classifier succeeded in 1200 ms", "AG2 Severity Classifier started". No result row exists for `streamed-bug`. Used by `SVC-EVENTS-01`, `SVC-EVENTS-02`, `SVC-EVENTS-03`, `SVC-EVENTS-05`, `SVC-EVENTS-07`.
- the following exist together; handle `interrupted-state`. Used by `SVC-EVENTS-04`, `SVC-RECOVERY-01`, `SVC-RECOVERY-02`, `SVC-RECOVERY-03`, `SVC-RECOVERY-04`, `SVC-RECOVERY-05`, `SVC-RECOVERY-06`, `SVC-RECOVERY-07`.
  - bug `crashed-bug` has status `processing` and no result row; run `crashed-run` has type `triage`, bug `crashed-bug`, status `running` and progress 1 of 5. Its steps are position 1 `succeeded` with a stored input and output, position 2 `running` with a stored input, positions 3 to 5 `pending`; it has exactly two log lines.
  - bug `queued-bug` has status `processing` and no result row; run `queued-run` has type `triage`, bug `queued-bug`, status `queued`, progress 0 of 5, no step and no log line.
  - run `crashed-index-run` has type `index`, no bug, status `running`, progress 3 of 20 and one log line.
  - bug `finished-bug` has status `processed` and exactly one row in each of the component, severity, analysis, plan and report tables; run `finished-run` has type `triage`, bug `finished-bug`, status `succeeded`, no error, progress 5 of 5, a finish time, five steps all `succeeded` with stored input and output, and at least five log lines.
  - bug `orphan-bug` has status `processing`, valid values for every other column, no result row, and no run refers to it.

**Configuration:**
- two API keys for the stand-in: `sk-test-valid`, which it accepts, and `sk-test-invalid`, which it rejects with an authentication error; the invalid key is also the canary for leak checks. Used by `WRK-OPERATIONS-04`.
- for service and worker items the runner's client factory builds an LLM client with the stand-in's `/v1` URL as an explicit base URL, the valid key, a 60-second timeout, 2 retries, the embedding model `text-embedding-3-small` and the chat model `gpt-4o-mini`, and the number of similar bugs passed to the Technical Analyst is the default 5, unless an item states otherwise; settings can be built with the root `.env` file disabled (an F01 deliverable)
- a client factory that raises an unexpected error with the text "boom" on its first call and returns the working client on every later call can be given to the runner. Used by `WRK-TRIAGE-04`.
- a client factory built from settings that have no API key (so that it fails as an unset key does) can be given to the runner. Used by `WRK-OPERATIONS-03`.
- for CLI processes the configuration comes only from the process environment: `DATABASE_URL` is set explicitly, `OPENAI_API_KEY` is `sk-test-valid`, the OpenAI client library's base-URL variable `OPENAI_BASE_URL` points at the stand-in's `/v1` URL, no other BugFlow variable is set, and no root `.env` file exists. Used by `E2E-CLI-RUN-01`, `E2E-CLI-RUN-02`, `E2E-CRASH-01`.
- the event source and the runner use the default 500 ms poll interval unless an item states otherwise
- `TZ=UTC`

**External dependencies:**
- the OpenAI API is replaced by a local stand-in. It answers embedding requests with deterministic 1,536-dimension vectors and accepts only the key `sk-test-valid`. It answers each chat request with a valid JSON object chosen by the agent role named in the request's system message ("You are Component Classifier.", "You are Severity Classifier.", "You are Technical Analyst.", "You are Resolution Manager.", "You are Bug Documenter."): component `backend`; severity `major`; an analysis with no referenced bug ids; a plan with status `planned`, team `backend`, an assignee profile, 5 target days and priority `high`; a document with an executive summary, one key takeaway and one next step. It can be scripted to answer the next chat requests of a chosen agent role, optionally only when the request's user message contains a chosen text, with a chosen reply, a chosen status or a chosen delay (including 10 seconds), for a chosen number of requests. It records every request (path, whether the key was accepted, model, temperature, response format, whether tools or functions were supplied, the messages) in arrival order and exposes the record; the record and the script can be cleared. No item needs network access or a real API key. Used by every item that starts a runner and by every `E2E-` item.
- the container image `pgvector/pgvector:pg17` is either already present locally or can be pulled from its registry

## Quality gates

Each gate must pass for the feature to be considered ready. All commands run from `backend/`.

- **Format** — `uv run ruff format .` — completes with exit code 0 and leaves the source tree formatted
- **Lint** — `uv run ruff check .` — completes with exit code 0 and reports no violations
- **Tests** — `uv run pytest` — completes with exit code 0; every non-integration test passes

## Coverage Manifest

| PRD Acceptance Criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|
| Starting a triage in the background returns a run ID within 1 s while the run continues | SVC-START-01, WRK-TRIAGE-01, WRK-TRIAGE-02, WRK-QUEUE-01 |
| Two concurrent triage starts for the same bug yield exactly one run and one state-conflict error | SVC-START-06, SVC-START-02, SVC-START-03 |
| "Triage all" creates one run per `open` bug, processes them sequentially, and a failure on one bug does not stop the others | SVC-START-ALL-01, SVC-START-ALL-02, SVC-START-ALL-03, WRK-TRIAGE-ALL-01, WRK-TRIAGE-ALL-02, WRK-TRIAGE-ALL-03 |
| After a simulated crash, startup recovery marks `running`/`queued` runs `failed` (`interrupted`) and moves their bugs from `processing` to `failed` | SVC-RECOVERY-01, SVC-RECOVERY-02, SVC-RECOVERY-03, SVC-RECOVERY-05, SVC-RECOVERY-06, SVC-RECOVERY-07, E2E-CRASH-01 |
| The event source returns steps and logs created after a cursor, including for a run started from the CLI | SVC-EVENTS-01, SVC-EVENTS-02, SVC-EVENTS-03, SVC-EVENTS-04, SVC-EVENTS-05, E2E-CLI-RUN-01, E2E-CLI-RUN-02 |

## Service

**Verification mode:** Invoke the public function/method directly in-process on an initialized database, using the engine and the runner the function takes; assert the returned value, thrown error, persisted side-effect, or the record of requests the stand-in received.

*Consumers outside this feature: F09 (API, Operations and Parity) consumes the background runner, the event source and the startup recovery, as declared in PRD Section 8.*

### Start run

**Common given:** a runner exists with the default configuration of the Prerequisites; the stand-in answers every agent with its default valid reply except where the item scripts it; its request record is empty.

#### `SVC-START-01` — triage returns a run id immediately
- given: `open-bug` exists; the stand-in delays its first Component Classifier reply by 3 seconds
- when: call `start_run` with kind `triage` and params `{bug_id: <id of open-bug>}`
- then:
  - the call returns within 1 second
  - the result holds exactly one run id
  - that run exists with type `triage`, the id of `open-bug` as its bug, and status `queued` or `running`
  - the stored status of `open-bug` is `processing`
  - the run is not in a final status when the call returns

#### `SVC-START-02` — processing bug is refused
- given: `processing-bug` exists
- when: call `start_run` with kind `triage` and params `{bug_id: <id of processing-bug>}`
- then:
  - a state-conflict error is raised with the message "Bug <id> is already being processed", where <id> is the id of `processing-bug`
  - the stored status of `processing-bug` is still `processing`
  - no run exists

#### `SVC-START-03` — processed bug is refused
- given: `processed-bug` exists
- when: call `start_run` with kind `triage` and params `{bug_id: <id of processed-bug>}`
- then:
  - a state-conflict error is raised with the message "Bug <id> has already been processed; reopen it first", where <id> is the id of `processed-bug`
  - the stored status of `processed-bug` is still `processed`
  - no run exists

#### `SVC-START-04` — unknown bug
- given: no bug has id 999999
- when: call `start_run` with kind `triage` and params `{bug_id: 999999}`
- then:
  - a not-found error is raised with the message "Bug 999999 not found"
  - no run exists

#### `SVC-START-05` — failed bug can be started again
- given: `failed-bug` exists
- when: call `start_run` with kind `triage` and params `{bug_id: <id of failed-bug>}`
- then:
  - the result holds exactly one run id
  - that run exists with type `triage` and the id of `failed-bug` as its bug
  - the stored status of `failed-bug` is `processing`

#### `SVC-START-06` — concurrent starts have one winner
- given: `open-bug` exists
- when: call `start_run` with kind `triage` and params `{bug_id: <id of open-bug>}` from two concurrent callers at the same time
- then:
  - exactly one call returns a result holding exactly one run id
  - the other call raises a state-conflict error
  - exactly one run of type `triage` exists for `open-bug`
  - the stored status of `open-bug` is `processing`

#### `SVC-START-07` — a triage request needs a target
- given: `open-bug` exists
- when: call `start_run` with kind `triage` and empty params
- then:
  - a validation error is raised with one field error on `params` and the message "Specify exactly one of bug_id or all"
  - no run exists
  - the stored status of `open-bug` is still `open`

#### `SVC-START-08` — unknown kind
- given: (default)
- when: call `start_run` with kind `reset` and empty params
- then:
  - a validation error is raised with one field error on `kind` and the message "must be one of triage, index, seed"
  - no run exists

#### `SVC-START-09` — index run is created before the call returns
- given: `seeded-bugs` exist
- when: call `start_run` with kind `index` and empty params
- then:
  - the call returns within 1 second
  - the result holds exactly one run id
  - that run exists with type `index`, no bug, and status `queued` or `running`

#### `SVC-START-10` — seed needs an initialized schema
- given: the database has no application tables
- when: call `start_run` with kind `seed` and empty params
- then:
  - a schema-not-initialized error is raised with the message "Database schema is not initialized; run 'bugflow db init'"
  - the database still has no application tables

### Start all

**Common given:** a runner exists with the default configuration of the Prerequisites; the stand-in answers every agent with its default valid reply except where the item scripts it; its request record is empty.

#### `SVC-START-ALL-01` — one run per open bug
- given: `three-open-bugs` exist; the stand-in delays its first Component Classifier reply by 3 seconds
- when: call `start_run` with kind `triage` and params `{all: true}`
- then:
  - the call returns within 1 second
  - the result holds exactly three run ids, belonging in this order to "Bug one", "Bug two" and "Bug three"
  - each run exists with type `triage`, its own bug, and status `queued` or `running`
  - the three bugs have stored status `processing`

#### `SVC-START-ALL-02` — only open bugs get a run
- given: `mixed-status-bugs` exist
- when: call `start_run` with kind `triage` and params `{all: true}`
- then:
  - the result holds exactly one run id, belonging to "Mixed open"
  - exactly one run of type `triage` exists
  - the stored statuses of "Mixed processed", "Mixed failed" and "Mixed processing" are unchanged

#### `SVC-START-ALL-03` — nothing to triage
- given: `processed-bug` exists and no bug has status `open`
- when: call `start_run` with kind `triage` and params `{all: true}`
- then:
  - the result holds no run id
  - no run exists
  - the stand-in received no chat request

### Run events

**Common given:** `streaming-state` exists; no runner is executing work.

#### `SVC-EVENTS-01` — all events of a run in progress
- given: (default)
- when: call `read_run_events` for `running-run` with no cursor
- then:
  - five step events are returned, one per position 1 to 5 in position order, each carrying the stored status of its step
  - three log events are returned, in the order the lines were written, each carrying its stored level and message
  - exactly one run event is returned, carrying status `running` and progress 1 of 5
  - all step events come before all log events, and the run event is last
  - the page reports the run as not finished

#### `SVC-EVENTS-02` — only events after the cursor
- given: (default), a cursor was obtained by reading all events of `running-run`; afterwards step 2 was finished as `succeeded` and two log lines "AG2 Severity Classifier succeeded in 800 ms" and "AG3 Technical Analyst started" were appended, by another connection
- when: call `read_run_events` for `running-run` with that cursor
- then:
  - exactly one step event is returned, for position 2, with status `succeeded`
  - exactly two log events are returned, in the order written, carrying the two new messages
  - no event is returned for the steps and log lines that were in the first read
  - no run event is returned

#### `SVC-EVENTS-03` — nothing new
- given: (default), a cursor was obtained by reading all events of `running-run` and no row has changed since
- when: call `read_run_events` for `running-run` with that cursor
- then:
  - no event is returned
  - the returned cursor equals the cursor that was passed
  - the page reports the run as not finished

#### `SVC-EVENTS-04` — a finished run
- given: `interrupted-state` exists, so `finished-run` is finished
- when: call `read_run_events` for `finished-run` with no cursor
- then:
  - five step events are returned, all with status `succeeded`
  - at least five log events are returned
  - the last event is a run event with status `succeeded`, progress 5 of 5 and a non-null finish time
  - the page reports the run as finished

#### `SVC-EVENTS-05` — iteration follows a run until it ends
- given: (default); 1.2 seconds after the iteration starts, another connection appends the log line "AG2 Severity Classifier succeeded in 800 ms" to `running-run` and then finishes the run as `succeeded`
- when: iterate `iter_run_events` for `running-run` to its end, noting the time at which each event arrives
- then:
  - the nine events that already exist (five step events, three log events, one run event) arrive within 1 second of the call
  - the appended log line arrives within 1 second of being written
  - the last event yielded is a run event with status `succeeded`
  - the iteration ends after that event, with no further event

#### `SVC-EVENTS-06` — unknown run
- given: no run has id 999999
- when: call `iter_run_events` for run 999999
- then:
  - a not-found error is raised at the call with the message "Run 999999 not found"

#### `SVC-EVENTS-07` — malformed cursor
- given: (default)
- when: call `read_run_events` for `running-run` with the cursor "not-a-cursor"
- then:
  - a validation error is raised with one field error on `after` and the message "invalid cursor"
  - no event is returned

### Startup recovery

**Common given:** `interrupted-state` exists; no runner is executing work unless an item states otherwise.

#### `SVC-RECOVERY-01` — interrupted runs are failed
- given: (default)
- when: call `recover_interrupted_runs`
- then:
  - `crashed-run`, `queued-run` and `crashed-index-run` have stored status `failed`
  - each of those three runs has the stored error "interrupted" and a non-null finish time
  - the result lists exactly the ids of those three runs as interrupted

#### `SVC-RECOVERY-02` — their bugs return to failed
- given: (default)
- when: call `recover_interrupted_runs`
- then:
  - `crashed-bug` and `queued-bug` have stored status `failed`
  - the result lists the ids of both bugs as recovered
  - no result row exists for `crashed-bug` or `queued-bug` in any of the component, severity, analysis, plan and report tables

#### `SVC-RECOVERY-03` — open steps are closed
- given: (default)
- when: call `recover_interrupted_runs`
- then:
  - step 1 of `crashed-run` is still `succeeded` with its stored output unchanged
  - step 2 of `crashed-run` has status `failed` and the stored error "interrupted"
  - steps 3, 4 and 5 of `crashed-run` have status `skipped`
  - `crashed-run` has a third log line at level ERROR

#### `SVC-RECOVERY-04` — finished work is untouched
- given: (default)
- when: call `recover_interrupted_runs`
- then:
  - `finished-run` still has status `succeeded` and no error
  - `finished-bug` still has status `processed`
  - the five result rows of `finished-bug` still exist
  - the result does not list `finished-run` or `finished-bug`

#### `SVC-RECOVERY-05` — an orphan processing bug is returned to failed
- given: (default)
- when: call `recover_interrupted_runs`
- then:
  - `orphan-bug` has stored status `failed`
  - the result lists the id of `orphan-bug` as recovered

#### `SVC-RECOVERY-06` — recovery is repeatable
- given: (default), and `recover_interrupted_runs` has already been called once
- when: call `recover_interrupted_runs` again
- then:
  - the result lists no run and no bug
  - `crashed-run` still has the stored error "interrupted" and exactly three log lines
  - the stored statuses of the interrupted runs and bugs are unchanged

#### `SVC-RECOVERY-07` — a recovered bug can be triaged again
- given: (default), `recover_interrupted_runs` has already been called once, and a runner exists with the default configuration; the stand-in answers every agent with its default valid reply
- when: call `start_run` with kind `triage` and params `{bug_id: <id of crashed-bug>}`
- then:
  - the result holds exactly one run id, and it is not the id of `crashed-run`
  - the stored status of `crashed-bug` is `processing`

## Worker

**Verification mode:** Trigger the work through the public start function of the runner; wait until the run reaches a final status or the runner is idle; observe the persisted rows and the stand-in's record of requests.

### Triage

**Common given:** a runner exists with the default configuration of the Prerequisites; the stand-in answers every agent with its default valid reply except where the item scripts it; its request record is empty.

#### `WRK-TRIAGE-01` — a started triage completes in the background
- given: `open-bug` exists
- when: start a triage of `open-bug` with `start_run`, then wait until its run reaches a final status
- then:
  - the run has status `succeeded` and no error
  - the stored status of `open-bug` is `processed`
  - exactly one row exists for `open-bug` in each of the component, severity, analysis, plan and report tables
  - the run has five steps, all with status `succeeded`
  - the run's progress is 5 of 5

#### `WRK-TRIAGE-02` — status and progress move forward
- given: `open-bug` exists; the stand-in delays its first Severity Classifier reply by 2 seconds
- when: start a triage of `open-bug` with `start_run`, then read the run's status, its progress and the bug's status every 100 ms until the run reaches a final status
- then:
  - the distinct run statuses observed, in order, are a subsequence of `queued`, `running`, `succeeded`, and the last one is `succeeded`
  - the status `running` was observed at least once
  - the observed progress counts never decrease
  - the last observation shows progress 5 of 5
  - every observation made before the run is final shows the bug with status `processing`

#### `WRK-TRIAGE-03` — an agent failure ends the run as failed
- given: `open-bug` exists; the stand-in replies to the Severity Classifier with severity "high" twice
- when: start a triage of `open-bug` with `start_run`, then wait until its run reaches a final status
- then:
  - the run has status `failed` and the error "AG2 returned invalid severity 'high'"
  - the stored status of `open-bug` is `failed`
  - no row exists for `open-bug` in any of the component, severity, analysis, plan and report tables
  - step 1 has status `succeeded`, step 2 has status `failed` and steps 3, 4 and 5 have status `skipped`

#### `WRK-TRIAGE-04` — an unexpected error does not stop the runner
- given: `three-open-bugs` exist; the runner's client factory raises "boom" on its first call and works afterwards
- when: start a triage of all open bugs with `start_run`, then wait until the runner is idle
- then:
  - the run of "Bug one" has status `failed` with a non-empty error, and "Bug one" has stored status `failed`
  - no step of the run of "Bug one" has status `running` or `pending`
  - the runs of "Bug two" and "Bug three" have status `succeeded`
  - "Bug two" and "Bug three" have stored status `processed`

### Triage all

**Common given:** `three-open-bugs` exist; a runner exists with the default configuration of the Prerequisites; the stand-in answers every agent with its default valid reply except where the item scripts it; its request record is empty.

#### `WRK-TRIAGE-ALL-01` — a failure does not stop the batch
- given: (default); the stand-in replies to the Severity Classifier with severity "high" twice, only for the request whose message contains "Bug two"
- when: start a triage of all open bugs with `start_run`, then wait until the runner is idle
- then:
  - exactly three runs of type `triage` exist, with statuses `succeeded`, `failed` and `succeeded` in the order of the bug ids
  - the stored statuses of "Bug one", "Bug two" and "Bug three" are `processed`, `failed` and `processed`
  - the failed run has the error "AG2 returned invalid severity 'high'"
  - no bug has status `processing`

#### `WRK-TRIAGE-ALL-02` — queued runs wait for the running one
- given: (default); the stand-in delays its first Component Classifier reply by 3 seconds
- when: start a triage of all open bugs with `start_run`, then read the database 1.5 seconds after the call returned
- then:
  - the run of "Bug one" has status `running`
  - the runs of "Bug two" and "Bug three" have status `queued`
  - no step exists for the runs of "Bug two" and "Bug three"
  - the three bugs have stored status `processing`

#### `WRK-TRIAGE-ALL-03` — runs execute one at a time
- given: (default)
- when: start a triage of all open bugs with `start_run`, then wait until the runner is idle
- then:
  - the finish time of the run of "Bug one" is not later than the start time of step 1 of the run of "Bug two"
  - the finish time of the run of "Bug two" is not later than the start time of step 1 of the run of "Bug three"
  - in the stand-in's record, no chat request whose message contains "Bug two" precedes the last chat request whose message contains "Bug one"

### Queueing

**Common given:** `three-open-bugs` exist; a runner exists with the default configuration of the Prerequisites; the stand-in answers every agent with its default valid reply except where the item scripts it; its request record is empty.

#### `WRK-QUEUE-01` — separate triage requests are queued
- given: (default); the stand-in delays its first Component Classifier reply for the request whose message contains "Bug one" by 3 seconds
- when: call `start_run` for a triage of "Bug one" and then, immediately, for a triage of "Bug two"
- then:
  - the second call returns within 1 second, while the run of "Bug one" is still not final
  - 1.5 seconds after the second call, the run of "Bug one" has status `running` and the run of "Bug two" has status `queued`
  - once the runner is idle, both runs have status `succeeded`
  - the finish time of the run of "Bug one" is not later than the start time of step 1 of the run of "Bug two"

### Operations

**Common given:** a runner exists with the default configuration of the Prerequisites; the stand-in answers every request with its default reply; its request record is empty.

#### `WRK-OPERATIONS-01` — seed runs in the background
- given: the database is initialized and holds no bug
- when: start a seed with `start_run`, then wait until its run reaches a final status
- then:
  - the run has type `seed`, status `succeeded` and progress 20 of 20
  - exactly 20 bugs exist, all with status `open`
  - the run has a log line "Seeded 20 bugs"

#### `WRK-OPERATIONS-02` — index runs in the background
- given: `seeded-bugs` exist
- when: start an index with `start_run`, then wait until its run reaches a final status
- then:
  - the run has type `index`, status `succeeded` and progress 20 of 20
  - 20 embeddings exist
  - the run has at least one log line starting with "Embedded batch"

#### `WRK-OPERATIONS-03` — missing key fails the index run
- given: `seeded-bugs` exist; the runner's client factory is the one built from settings without an API key
- when: start an index with `start_run`, then wait until its run reaches a final status
- then:
  - the run has status `failed` and the error "OPENAI_API_KEY is not set"
  - no embedding exists
  - the stand-in received no request

#### `WRK-OPERATIONS-04` — invalid key fails the index run without leaking it
- given: `seeded-bugs` exist; the runner's client factory uses the key `sk-test-invalid`
- when: start an index with `start_run`, then wait until its run reaches a final status
- then:
  - the run has status `failed` and the error "OpenAI authentication failed"
  - no embedding exists
  - the key `sk-test-invalid` appears in no run error and no run log line

## E2E

**Verification mode:** Run the system as separate operating-system processes: spawn the `bugflow` binary as a child process against the database and the stand-in, and, in the process that runs the contract, read events through the public event and recovery functions; assert the events, the persisted rows and the child's exit status.

### CLI-started run

**Common given:** the CLI environment of the Prerequisites; the stand-in answers every agent with its default valid reply except where the item scripts it; its request record is empty.

#### `E2E-CLI-RUN-01` — a run started by the CLI is streamed from another process
- given: `open-bug` exists; the stand-in delays its first Severity Classifier reply by 3 seconds
- when: start `uv run bugflow triage --bug <id>` from `backend/` as a child process without waiting for it and, as soon as a triage run of `open-bug` exists, iterate `iter_run_events` for that run from the contract's own process until the iterator ends
- then:
  - the iterator ends after yielding a run event with status `succeeded`
  - for each position 1 to 5, the last step event yielded has status `succeeded`
  - a step event for position 2 with status `running` was yielded before the child process exited
  - the log events yielded are in increasing log id order and include the line "AG1 Component Classifier started"
  - the child process exits with code 0

#### `E2E-CLI-RUN-02` — resuming after a cursor on a CLI-started run
- given: a triage run of `open-bug` was produced by `uv run bugflow triage --bug <id>` in a separate process that exited with code 0; all events of that run were read from the start with `read_run_events`, and the cursor of the third event was noted
- when: call `read_run_events` for that run with the noted cursor
- then:
  - the events returned are exactly the events that followed the third event in the full read, in the same order
  - no event that was at or before the third event is returned
  - the page reports the run as finished

### Crash

**Common given:** the CLI environment of the Prerequisites; the stand-in answers every agent with its default valid reply except where the item scripts it; its request record is empty.

#### `E2E-CRASH-01` — a killed triage is recovered
- given: `open-bug` exists; the stand-in delays its first Severity Classifier reply by 10 seconds; `uv run bugflow triage --bug <id>` was started as a child process and was killed abruptly (SIGKILL) once step 2 of its run had status `running`; the run still has status `running` and the bug still has status `processing`
- when: call `recover_interrupted_runs`
- then:
  - the run has status `failed` and the stored error "interrupted"
  - `open-bug` has stored status `failed`
  - step 1 is `succeeded`, step 2 is `failed` with the stored error "interrupted", and steps 3, 4 and 5 are `skipped`
  - no row exists for `open-bug` in any of the component, severity, analysis, plan and report tables
  - reading the events of the run from the start ends with a run event with status `failed`
